name: CrypticScan
description: Automated penetration testing framework to identify and assess vulnerabilities in networks, applications, and systems. Built with a modern UI using Electron, and powered by Flask for the backend, this tool integrates popular security tools like Nmap, OpenVAS, OWASP ZAP, Metasploit, and SQLmap to perform comprehensive security assessments.

name: C0mmander
description: Docker-based pentesting environment with VNC access and essential tools like Metasploit, Nmap, and Burp Suite.

name: Penetration-Testing-with-Metasploit
description: The primary goal of this project is to enable learners to proficiently utilize Metasploit, a powerful penetration testing tool, to exploit vulnerable machines effectively.

name: MetaMap-AI
description: This is a cybersecurity project that leverages generative artificial intelligence in order to chain together nmap and metasploit as one tool.
